name: Jokneam
overview: Jokneam is identified in Scripture as a city associated with the tribe of Zebulun, specifically designated as a Levitical city for the families of Merari, highlighting its role in the organization of the Levites among Israel (Joshua 21:34). It is geographically noted near Carmel and the river before it, marking its significance in territorial boundaries (Joshua 19:11; 12:22). These references emphasize Jokneam's place within God's provision for the Levites and its location within the inheritance of Zebulun.
